name: Core-engineering campus pass — mechanical fresher with concrete stack

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Walk me through your final-year project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My final-year project was a vibration-damping mount for the BHEL turbine rotor test rig. I designed the geometry in SolidWorks, ran modal analysis in ANSYS, and validated the FFT plots against the lab measurements. CGPA 8.4. We reduced peak vibration amplitude by 22%.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you keen on joining us for the GET role?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I read about your recent acquisition of the renewables division and the Q3 launch of the new turbine line. The leadership principles around 'customer obsession' resonate with the rotor-balancing work I want to grow into.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My final semester ends in May, available to join from June 10, open to posting in Trichy or Haridwar — I'm flexible on relocation.
